Who We Are

A youth-led movement, not just an organisation

Project हम is a youth-led student initiative founded on the belief that meaningful change begins with us. We are a group of students committed to creating impact through community drives — spending time with people, listening, and showing up, one drive at a time.

From spreading awareness to lending a helping hand, we work towards building a more compassionate, inclusive, and empowered society.

"Our mission is simple: to make compassion a way of life."

How It Started

Our Story

Project हम was started by two Chandigarh students, Reet S. Ghavri and Mehnoor Mahal — close friends, both in the 12th grade — on a simple idea: growing up shouldn't mean growing distant from the people around us.

Between classes, exams, and the pressure to build a career, it's easy for young people to lose touch with their communities. So they decided to put that same time and energy into something else — visiting people who needed company, listening to their stories, and simply showing up.

What started with the two of them has grown into a team of about 20 student volunteers, aged 16 to 19, from schools and colleges across the city. Before every drive, the team researches the community they're visiting and its needs — and volunteers personally chip in from their own pocket money to fund it. Drives happen once a month, by design: small enough to manage well, consistent enough to matter.

Our Name

What does "हम" mean?

"हम" represents togetherness, responsibility, and collective impact.

We believe that even the smallest efforts, when carried out with unity and intent, can lead to something truly powerful.

What We Stand For

Vision, mission & values

Our Vision

A society where kindness is a way of life, and everyone feels seen, valued, and supported.

Our Mission

To inspire compassionate action through youth-led volunteering.

Our Values

Empathy, compassion, respect, integrity, inclusivity, and collaboration.

Our Purpose

To inspire kindness, foster human connection, and strengthen communities.

What We Do

One drive, every month

Right now, everything we do comes together in one place: our monthly community drive. Small, consistent, and done properly.

Research The Need

Before each drive, the team studies the community we're visiting and what it actually needs.

Pool Our Pocket Money

Volunteers personally chip in from their own pocket money to fund every drive.

Show Up, Every Month

One drive a month, by design — small enough to manage well, consistent enough to matter.

Spend Real Time

Conversations, care kits, stone painting, music, games — whatever helps people feel a little less alone.
